parts.text:
Записать доход за 26.07.2026:

```bash
cd /home/kasiro/.agents/skills/receipt-parser-fns/scripts
python3 -c "
import sqlite3, os
db = os.path.expanduser('~/.local/share/receipt-cache/receipts.db')
conn = sqlite3.connect(db)
conn.execute('INSERT INTO earnings (date, source, hours, rate, total, comment) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
             ('2026-07-26', 'Добрянка', 10, 280, 2800, 'смена 12-22'))
conn.commit()

# Показать все доходы
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
rows = conn.execute('SELECT * FROM earnings ORDER BY date').fetchall()
total = 0
for r in rows:
    print(f'{r[\"date\"]} | {r[\"source\"]:10s} | {r[\"total\"]:>7.0f}₽ | {r[\"comment\"]}')
    total += r['total']
print(f'---')
print(f'ИТОГО: {total:.0f}₽')
conn.close()
"
```
